ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption recovery-inhibit chain (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin + service kill burst)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature command burst LockBit's encryptor (LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0) executes seconds before file encryption: shadow-copy deletion, BCD recovery disablement, WBAdmin catalog wipe, and mass stop of MSSQL/Veeam/Defender/backup services. Two or more of these actions from the same parent within a 5-minute window is essentially exclusive to ransomware staging and tracks LockBit's hard-coded preflight routine.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs dc(Processes.process_name) as unique_procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.parent_process_id) as parent_ids from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*resize*shadowstorage*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*ExclusionExtension*" OR Processes.process="*stop*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*stop*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*stop*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*stop*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*stop*Acronis*" OR Processes.process="*stop*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*stop*mepocs*" OR Processes.process="*stop*memtas*" OR Processes.process="*/IM*MsMpEng*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_id _time span=5m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where unique_procs >= 2 AND mvcount(cmds) >= 3
| eval action="LockBit pre-encryption preflight"
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let InhibitRecovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup","backup"))
    | extend ChainStep = "InhibitRecovery";
let DefenderDisable = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "Set-MpPreference"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","DisableScriptScanning","ExclusionExtension","ExclusionPath","DisableIOAVProtection")
    | extend ChainStep = "DefenderDisable";
let ServiceKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop "," delete ","/IM ","/F")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLAgent","SQLWriter","BackupExec","Acronis","SAVAdminService","SophosAgent","Sense","WinDefend","mepocs","memtas","vss","VSS","MsMpEng","AVP","avast","AVG")
    | extend ChainStep = "ServiceKill";
InhibitRecovery
| union DefenderDisable, ServiceKill
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize Steps = make_set(ChainStep),
            DistinctBinaries = dcount(FileName),
            UniqueCmdLines = dcount(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            ParentImage = any(InitiatingProcessFolderPath),
            ParentCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where array_length(Steps) >= 2 and UniqueCmdLines >= 3   // 2 distinct chain phases + 3 commands
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let Preflight = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | extend ChainStep = case(
        Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and (Cmd has "delete shadows" or Cmd has "resize shadowstorage"), "InhibitRecovery",
        Img endswith "\\wmic.exe" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete", "InhibitRecovery",
        Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (Cmd has "recoveryenabled" or Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy"), "InhibitRecovery",
        Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and Cmd has "delete" and (Cmd has "catalog" or Cmd has "systemstatebackup"), "InhibitRecovery",
        (Img endswith "\\powershell.exe" or Img endswith "\\pwsh.exe") and Cmd has "set-mppreference" and (Cmd has "disablerealtimemonitoring" or Cmd has "exclusionextension" or Cmd has "exclusionpath" or Cmd has "disablebehaviormonitoring"), "DefenderDisable",
        (Img endswith "\\net.exe" or Img endswith "\\net1.exe" or Img endswith "\\sc.exe" or Img endswith "\\taskkill.exe")
            and (Cmd has "stop " or Cmd has " delete " or Cmd has "/im " or Cmd has "/f")
            and (Cmd has "veeam" or Cmd has "mssql" or Cmd has "sqlagent" or Cmd has "backupexec" or Cmd has "acronis" or Cmd has "sophos" or Cmd has "windefend" or Cmd has "sense" or Cmd has "mepocs" or Cmd has "memtas" or Cmd has "msmpeng"), "ServiceKill",
        "")
    | where ChainStep != ""
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$";
Preflight
| summarize Steps = make_set(ChainStep),
            DistinctBinaries = dcount(NewProcessName),
            UniqueCmdLines = dcount(CommandLine),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Parent = any(ParentProcessName)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, ProcessId, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where array_length(Steps) >= 2 and UniqueCmdLines >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*) OR @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *ShadowCopy*delete*) OR @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"*) OR @CommandLine:(*"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*) OR @CommandLine:(*"wbadmin delete catalog"* OR *"wbadmin DELETE CATALOG"*) OR @CommandLine:(*"Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring"* OR *"Set-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension"* OR *"Set-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"*) OR (@CommandLine:(*"net stop"* OR *"net  stop"* OR *"sc stop"* OR *"sc delete"*) AND @CommandLine:(*Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *MSSQL* OR *SQLAgent* OR *BackupExec* OR *Acronis* OR *SophosAgent* OR *WinDefend* OR *mepocs* OR *memtas* OR *MsMpEng*)) ) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|net1?|sc|taskkill|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| (regex("(?i)delete\\s+shadows", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)recoveryenabled\\s+no", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)wbadmin.*delete\\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)set-mppreference.*(disablerealtimemonitoring|exclusionextension|exclusionpath|disablebehaviormonitoring)", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)(stop|delete)\\s+(veeam|mssql|sqlagent|sqlwriter|backupexec|acronis|sophos|windefend|sense|mepocs|memtas|msmpeng)", field=CommandLine))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, bin(_time, 5m)], function=[count(as=Hits), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true), count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctBins)])
| DistinctBins >= 2 AND Hits >= 3
| sort(field=_time, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The LockBit family (2.0, 3.0/Black, Green, 5.0) hard-codes a near-identical preflight burst into the encryptor binary: vssadmin/wmic shadow deletion → bcdedit /set recoveryenabled No → wbadmin delete catalog → bulk net stop / sc stop / taskkill of MSSQL, Veeam, BackupExec, Acronis, Sophos, Defender (mepocs/memtas service lists are taken from leaked LockBit builder defaults). Affiliates from CrowdS

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit StealBit / rclone-to-MEGA exfiltration from server estate
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit's signature double-extortion exfil step: server-side execution of StealBit (the gang's bespoke exfiltrator) or rclone configured against MEGA/pCloud/Dropbox/AWS, often launched from a Temp/PerfLogs directory by a PsExec/wmiexec parent. Anchored on the rclone subcommand grammar plus MEGA SDK DNS to differentiate from legit admin rclone use.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_path) as paths values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","StealBit.exe","stealbit.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*copy*","*sync*","*move*")) OR (Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe") OR Processes.process="*--config*" AND Processes.process IN ("*mega:*","*pcloud:*","*dropbox:*","*ftp:*","*remote:*") OR Processes.process_path IN ("*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*") AND Processes.process IN ("*copy*","*sync*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category="cloud_storage" OR All_Traffic.app IN ("mega.nz","mega.io","mega.co.nz","pcloud.com","dropboxapi.com","sendspace.com","transfer.sh") OR All_Traffic.dest_port=443 by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.app
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
    | rename src as dest
  ]
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ExfilDomains = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","sendspace.com","transfer.sh","anonfiles.com","file.io"]);
let ExfilProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
              or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
              or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
              or FileName matches regex @"(?i)stealbit.*\.exe"
              or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "StealBit")
           or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone","--config") 
                 and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","copyto")
                 and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","pcloud:","dropbox:","ftp:","remote:","--no-check-certificate","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SHA256, ProcessId;
let ExfilNet = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ExfilDomains) or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(mega|pcloud|sendspace|anonfiles|transfer\.sh|file\.io)"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              NetProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              NetParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
ExfilProc
| join kind=inner ExfilNet on DeviceName
| where NetTime between (Timestamp - 5m .. Timestamp + 1h)
| summarize FirstProcSeen = min(Timestamp),
            FirstEgress = min(NetTime),
            DistinctDestinations = dcount(RemoteUrl),
            Destinations = make_set(RemoteUrl, 15),
            ExfilCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            DropPath = any(FolderPath),
            Parents = make_set(ParentName, 5)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, SHA256, ProcessId
| where DistinctDestinations >= 1
| extend SuspiciousDropPath = iff(DropPath has_any (@"\PerfLogs\", @"\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\"), true, false)
| order by FirstProcSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ExfilDomains = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","sendspace.com","transfer.sh","anonfiles.com","file.io"]);
let ExfilProc = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | where Img endswith "\\rclone.exe"
         or Img matches regex @"(?i)\\stealbit.*\.exe$"
         or (Cmd has "rclone" and (Cmd has "copy" or Cmd has "sync" or Cmd has "move")
               and (Cmd has "mega:" or Cmd has "pcloud:" or Cmd has "dropbox:" or Cmd has "ftp:" or Cmd has "remote:" or Cmd has "--transfers" or Cmd has "--multi-thread-streams"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
              ParentProcessName, ProcessId;
let ExfilNet = ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DnsQuery has_any (ExfilDomains)
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DnsQuery;
ExfilProc
| join kind=inner (ExfilNet) on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where NetTime between (TimeGenerated - 5m .. TimeGenerated + 1h)
| summarize FirstProcSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            FirstEgress = min(NetTime),
            Destinations = make_set(DnsQuery, 15),
            DistinctDest = dcount(DnsQuery),
            ExfilCmd = any(CommandLine),
            DropPath = any(NewProcessName)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, ProcessId
| where DistinctDest >= 1
| extend SuspiciousDropPath = iff(DropPath has_any ("\\PerfLogs\\","\\Temp\\","\\Users\\Public\\","\\Windows\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\"), true, false)
| order by FirstProcSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) ( @Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE OR *\stealbit.exe OR *\StealBit.exe OR *\STEALBIT.EXE) OR (@CommandLine:*rclone* AND @CommandLine:(*copy* OR *sync* OR *move* OR *copyto*) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *pcloud\:* OR *dropbox\:* OR *ftp\:* OR *remote\:* OR *--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams*)) OR (@Image:(*\PerfLogs\* OR *\perflogs\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\ProgramData\*) AND @CommandLine:(*copy* OR *sync*) AND @CommandLine:(*mega* OR *pcloud* OR *dropbox*)) ) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR ImageFileName=/\\stealbit.*\.exe$/i OR (regex("(?i)rclone", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(?i)(copy|sync|move|copyto)", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(?i)(mega:|pcloud:|dropbox:|ftp:|remote:|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams)", field=CommandLine)))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=DnsRequest
    | DomainName=/(mega\.(nz|io|co\.nz)|pcloud\.com|dropboxapi\.com|sendspace\.com|transfer\.sh|anonfiles\.com|file\.io)/i
  }, field=aid, include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])

ucs.rationale: Mandiant, CISA AA23-165A and TrendMicro all document the same staging recipe across LockBit affiliates (BITWISE SPIDER ecosystem, Storm-0506, UNC4393): once domain admin is held, the operator drops rclone.exe (sometimes renamed) or LockBit's bespoke StealBit binary to PerfLogs / Windows\Temp / Users\Public on a file server, then runs `rclone copy/sync` against a MEGA, pCloud, Dropbox or generic FT
